category_title: Students with disabilities who do not respond to teacher questions or volunteer for individual performances
minimal_context: The teacher is asking fourth-grade students in the inclusive music classroom to volunteer to play prepared pieces on their recorders.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are going to play our prepared pieces on the recorders now. Who would like to volunteer to play first?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Sits quietly and does not raise his hand to volunteer.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Raul volunteered, but we need more students. Who else wants to volunteer?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks at the recorder but does not volunteer to play.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Adam, would you like to volunteer to play your prepared piece?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Does not volunteer to play the prepared piece and does not respond to the question.)
